welcome.title: Welcome to MYVAGON
welcome.description: This short tour shows you the essential steps to set up MYVAGON and start shipping.

dashboard.title: Your Dashboard
dashboard.description: Track KPIs, today's schedule, live map, and your shipment board from one place.

addresses.title: Set Up Addresses
addresses.description: Add the pickup locations you use most often and the customer addresses typically used for deliveries.

products.title: Create Products
products.description: Create your product master by organizing what you ship by product category and product type, so they can be reused across shipments.

partners.title: Invite Your Partners
partners.description: Invite your existing carrier and driver partners to MYVAGON to digitize your dispatching and send them private shipment offers.
partners.tip: Tip: Get started quickly by inviting just one carrier and assigning your first shipment digitally!

priceLists.title: Price Lists
priceLists.description: Create and manage price lists for your lanes and carriers, so rates are ready when you send shipment offers.

erpOrders.title: Orders
erpOrders.description: Import or sync orders into MYVAGON to create shipments faster without re-entering data.

orders.title: Orders
orders.description: Import or sync orders into MYVAGON to create shipments faster without re-entering data.

createShipment.title: Create Your Shipment
createShipment.description: Create a shipment by selecting products, pickup and delivery locations, then send the load offer to your carrier or driver partners.

manageShipments.title: Manage shipments
manageShipments.description: Track, edit, and monitor all your shipments in one place as they move from creation to delivery.

tutorials.title: Video Guides
tutorials.description: Access short video tutorials anytime to learn how to use features or refresh your knowledge.

support.title: Support & Feedback
support.description: Reach our team for help, report issues, or share feedback anytime from here.

finish.title: You're All Set
finish.description: You can restart this tour anytime from Settings if you need a quick refresher.
